questionText:

Metro Automotives Ltd. produces precision gearboxes for commercial tractors. To eliminate worker soldiering and optimize shopfloor operations, the factory director implemented F.W. 1. The Gang Boss is responsible for setting up machines, tools, and materials so that workers can begin their tasks without delays.
